pages.text: The $(bold)Mutator$() is the machine for producing $(bold)specific strain seeds$(). It combines seeds, a strain extract, and fluid oil to mutate the seeds into a named strain.$(br)$(br)$(bold)Inputs:$()$(br)• Any weed seeds (slot 1)$(br)• A strain's extract (slot 2)$(br)• $(bold)300 mB Hemp Oil or Hash Oil$() (fluid tank)$(br)$(br)$(bold)Output:$() The corresponding strain's seeds$(br)$(br)Example: Any seeds + White Widow Extract + 300 mB Hemp Oil → White Widow Seeds

$(bold)Getting Strain Extracts:$()$(br)$(br)$(bold)Option A — Extract from existing weed:$()$(br)Grind the strain's weed → put in Extractor → get that strain's extract$(br)$(br)$(bold)Option B — DNA Route (for strains you don't have):$()$(br)1. Extractor: Hemp Seeds → DNA Strand$(br)2. Synthesizer: DNA Strand + 3 strain reagents → Filled DNA Strand$(br)3. Sequencer: Filled DNA Strand + Base Extract → Strain Extract$(br)$(br)See the Synthesizer and Sequencer entries, and each Strain's entry for specific reagents.
